routes.bounded_read: The complete pinned acorr_lm and het_arch functions were read. het_arch squares the supplied residual series and delegates to acorr_lm. With nonrobust covariance, fixed nlags and ddof zero, acorr_lm trims the first nlags observations, fits an intercept plus exact lags one through nlags by OLS, and returns LM=(trimmed observation count)*centered R-squared.
routes.claim_boundary: Supports deterministic ARCH-LM arithmetic and implementation alignment only. It does not establish a WTI trading edge, prescribe sixty monthly returns or six lags, validate the empirical-median state boundary, select continuation direction, prove CFD equivalence, or provide activity, profitability, risk, or portfolio evidence. No p-value is imported.
